patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Tiendanube and VTEX share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than VTEX's shape. Choose VTEX only if your buying job matches “Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify kee” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Workflow advantage: Tiendanube leans shared coverage; VTEX leans wholesale-b2b. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Tiendanube and VTEX share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala ; VTEX is Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. Shopify keeps the SaaS award..
- Company-size focus: Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market) vs VTEX (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Tiendanube-leaning — vs VTEX-leaning wholesale-b2b.
- Researched limits: Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; VTEX — No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone.

Limitations — Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth; VTEX: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone; Enterprise sales and implementation cycles versus Shopify SMB speed.

Poor-fit cases: Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · VTEX is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published self-serve monthly tiles — hard to shortlist on list price alone · Avoid Tiendanube if you actually need VTEX's motion (Enterprise commerce SaaS — contact-sales get-started only; no invented floors. S)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
